name: Patna Cube Challenge 2025

venue.name: City Centre Mall
venue.address: City Centre Mall, Utkarsh Sfatik Ltd, Budh Marg, Lodipur, Patna 800001

information:
*  **Participants must bring their own cubes.**
* Make sure to be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. Late entries won't be allowed to participate.
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your goverment ID card for verification
* Participants are expected to volunteer and will be assigned with roles as judges, scramblers, or runners, with the exception of newcomers.
